_comment: Which uBlock Origin filter lists Nadhr enables by default, and why.
Rule (owner decision 2026-11-27): a list may be on by default only if its terms
Ambiguous lists are excluded; no permission is sought from providers (owner decision 2026-11-27).
explicitly allow personal, enterprise, government and commercial use. Ambiguous
or restricted lists are off by default even though uBlock Origin may enable them;
users can still turn any list on themselves in the uBlock Origin dashboard.
utils/prepare_ublock.py enforces this file at build time and fails the build if
uBlock Origin adds a default-on list that has not been reviewed here.

excluded.urlhaus-1: Derived from abuse.ch URLhaus. abuse.ch terms (21 Oct 2026): free for not-for-profit use; commercial use 'may require a paid subscription' (Spamhaus). Ambiguous for Nadhr's intended use. Excluded.
excluded.plowe-0: Peter Lowe's list: no licence; the site says 'Feel free to combine this list with yours ... and put it up on the web', which does not explicitly cover commercial use. Excluded.
